info.name: Dikichi Order System - Pengujian API v2.0 (GET dan POST)
info.description: Pengujian black-box API v2 (resource Order) melalui API Gateway. Menjalankan berurutan: login, POST, GET, lalu pembayaran.

item.name: 00 Autentikasi (POST /api/v1/auth/login)
Login MASTER
Login CASHIER
Login KITCHEN
01 Order v2 POST (POST /api/v2/orders)
POST pesanan v2 oleh tamu tanpa token

exec: pm.test("Header Location menunjuk pesanan v2", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.eql("/api/v2/orders/" + j.id));
pm.test("Medan datar v1 tidak ada", () => { ["customerName","outletId","tableCode","totalAmount"].forEach(k => pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property(k)); });

pm.test("Snapshot item dan subtotal", () => { pm.expect(j.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); const i = j.items[0]; pm.expect(i.quantity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(i.subtotal).to.eql(i.unitPrice * i.quantity); });

pm.test("paymentSummary UNPAID dengan medan pembayaran null", () => { const p = j.paymentSummary; pm.expect(p.paymentStatus).to.eql("UNPAID"); pm.expect(p.totalAmount).to.eql(j.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.subtotal, 0)); pm.expect(p.paymentMethod).to.eql(null); pm.expect(p.amountTendered).to.eql(null); pm.expect(p.change).to.eql(null); });

item.name: POST pesanan dengan body datar v1

exec: pm.test("Format kesalahan seragam", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.all.keys("timestamp", "status", "code", "message", "path", "errors"); pm.expect(j.errors).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(j.path).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Medan customer dan location dilaporkan", () => { const f = pm.response.json().errors.map(e => e.field); pm.expect(f).to.include.members(["customer", "location"]); });

item.name: GET daftar pesanan v2 oleh CASHIER

exec: pm.test("Memuat pesanan v2 yang baru dibuat", () => { const f = j.find(o => o.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("orderId")); pm.expect(f).to.exist; pm.expect(f.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(f.paymentSummary.paymentStatus).to.eql("UNPAID"); });
pm.test("Hanya antrean PENDING dan ACCEPTED", () => j.forEach(o => pm.expect(o.status).to.be.oneOf(["PENDING", "ACCEPTED"])));
pm.test("Urut dari yang terlama", () => { const t = j.map(o => o.createdAt); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort()); });

item.name: POST pay v2 CASH dengan uang cukup

exec: pm.test("Medan datar v1 tidak ada", () => { ["customerName","outletId","tableCode","totalAmount"].forEach(k => pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property(k)); });

pm.test("paymentSummary PAID tunai lengkap", () => { const p = j.paymentSummary; const total = j.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.subtotal, 0); pm.expect(p.paymentStatus).to.eql("PAID"); pm.expect(p.paymentMethod).to.eql("CASH"); pm.expect(p.totalAmount).to.eql(total); pm.expect(p.amountTendered).to.eql(1000000); pm.expect(p.change).to.eql(1000000 - total); });
